file_sha256_algorithm: SHA256 raw file bytes. files keys are repository destination paths; source_relative_path resolves within the named local snapshot. aggregate = SHA256(json.dumps(files,sort_keys=True).encode()) using Python default separators/ensure_ascii=True. This manifest itself is excluded from the self-hash map and bound by outer publication receipt.
excluded: node_modules, historical candidate chats, historical Office reports, external secrets, provenance screenshots; full local 9case snapshot is not claimed fully published by this CI subset.
